reviews.title: Good Product with Minor Annoyances
reviews.comment:
Pros:
Excellent build quality.
Stylish.
Affordable.
Easy to build in.
Plenty of room for cable management in the rear of the case.
Cons:
Included ARGB fans run at 100% on first install. Have to manage a fan curve in the motherboard BIOS.
Front panel connectors to the motherboard are reversed for Power and Reset
reviews.author: FH

reviews.title: Stocky, Sleek, and Practical at a Good Price
reviews.comment:
This is a fantastic "fishtank" style mid-size PC case. It has great cooling/airflow capabilities with tons of tiny holes in the case for intake and exhaust air in the side, rear, and top panels. It also is prepped for mounting two additional intake fans in the main cabin of the case above the PSU housing area for additional cooling.
It fits a Micro-ATX size motherboard perfectly. Has lots of openings in the mounting panel around the motherboard mount for cables. I believe it can also fit a mini-ITX motherboard as well. Also has plenty of conveniently located anchor points to help with cable management using a combo of zip-ties, velcro straps, etc. It comes with a few velcro straps and several zip ties for further convenience.
This case is even prepared for Back Connect motherboards.
For most AM4 chipsets motherboards, they will not be able to enjoy the USB 3.0 bandwidth cable that powers the front panel USB ports, so an adapter for a USB 2.0 header will be required. Not a knock on the case, just an awareness note for PC builders.
I love that this case has a buying option for additional fans at a very reasonable price.
Because it is a mini version of the V100 Lian Li case, some space is lost in the PSU housing area for stowing away cables and especially putting in more hard drive storage below decks. But with some thoughtful cable management, it is still spacious enough for most PC builds.
Speaking of storage: there is a nice spot on the other side of the MB mounting panel for mounting a SATA-connector SSD (2.5 in.). I don't currently take advantage of this feature.
My build with this case:
MB: Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2
CPU: AMD Ryzen 5 2600
CPU Cooler: Wraith Stealth
RAM: 2x16gb RipJaws 2933MT/s CL18
GPU: MSI GelTX 1660 Gaming X 6G
PSU: Seasonic S12II 500W 80+ Bronze (non-modular)
Added 3 exhaust fans under the top panel and had room for 2 intake fans above the PSU housing (mentioned earlier).
reviews.author: Drew Pickens

reviews.title: Fantastic case on a budget
reviews.comment: Case is awesome and great at the price point. The lights are sick and the overall look is a lot better than what i had before. It can be a tad bit noisy but I haven’t fiddled with fan curves so that may just be me. It was also really fun putting together
reviews.author: Aidan

reviews.title: Case of the year
reviews.comment: Cheap, high quality, toolless panels, easy to build in, spacious but not oversized. This is a phenomenal looking case, much better than the usual fishbowl. The RGB strip is a very nice touch and the included fans are quiet and look nice. Fit and finish is very impressive for the price. So far case of the year!
reviews.author: Lauterec
